intent: audit-surface Phase 2 Commit I: Q3 promotion + error-message hardening
notes: First code delivery of the 2026-08-14 Enterprise audit surface implementation plan (r8). Phase 2 Commit I of 3 (Commit J = new Phase-1-gap surfaces for Q2/Q4/Q5; Commit K = docs + smoke-test protocol). Scope-disciplined hardening on the existing Claude-first path — no new endpoints or CLI verbs in this commit. All Architect ratifications from Phase 1 exit (R1-R5) honored.

**Q3 promotion — server-side `unlinked` filter.** `enterprise/app/routes/transcripts.py::list_transcripts` gains an `unlinked: bool = Query(False)` param wired to a HAVING clause on the existing outerjoin+group_by (`func.count(CommitTranscriptLink.id) == 0`). The CLI `transcripts list --unlinked` now passes `?unlinked=true` to the server; the pre-existing client-side filter stays as defensive fallback so a new CLI works against an older server with no `unlinked=true` support. Flips Q3 from "EXISTS (with efficiency caveat)" per Phase 1 audit-question-surface artifact §3 to plain EXISTS. Complements the `unlinked_recent_transcripts` view (Migration 010) — API is unbounded, view is bounded to last 7 days; both surface the same investigation queue.

**Missing `~/.gator/machine-id` fail-fast** — `enterprise/enterprise-cli/gator_enterprise_cli/commands/transcripts.py::_handle_pull` now exits with code 2 + actionable error message pointing at `gator init` as the fix, at the top of the pull command before any commit or transcript ingest fires. Prior behavior silently uploaded with `machine_id="unknown"` (from the `_read_machine_id() or "unknown"` fallback in the payload assembly), which would collapse every transcript ingested in this state into a single synthesized machine row + break the `strong_machine_repo_time` linkage basis fleet-wide.

**Missing `~/.claude/projects/` informative warning** — `transcripts_discovery.py` gains a public `claude_root_path()` accessor (returns whatever `_default_claude_root()` resolves to, honoring the `CLAUDE_TRANSCRIPTS_ROOT` env override). CLI `_handle_pull` checks the root exists before running discovery + prints a warning to stderr if not. Non-fatal — operators may legitimately have no Claude transcripts on the machine; the warning explains WHY zero transcripts were discovered so the operator isn't stuck debugging a silent zero-item pull.

**Malformed-JSONL fatal-skip** — `transcripts_discovery.DiscoveredTranscript` gains an `unreadable: bool = False` field, set to `True` in the `OSError` branch of `_parse_jsonl_metadata` (file unreadable on open). CLI `_handle_pull` skips these records with a named-file diagnostic to stderr (source path + parse error) instead of attempting to upload a file it never actually read. Non-fatal parse issues (missing sessionId → filename fallback) keep `unreadable=False` because the file is still usable evidence — those still upload with the fallback session id + parse_error field visible to the operator.

**Duplicate-ingest verification, no code change.** Existing upsert path at `enterprise/app/routes/ingest.py:536-575` already returns `status="updated"` (not 500) on re-ingest of the same `(org, machine, vendor, vendor_session_id)` tuple; CLI's `_handle_pull` summary already distinguishes `transcripts ingested (new)` from `transcripts updated`. The 4th target failure mode from the Phase 2 plan §4 error-message audit is verified informative — no fix needed. Documented in the commit body so future audits know it was checked.
**Regression pins.** New tests wire through the two new hardening surfaces:

`enterprise/tests/test_ingest_routes.py::TestListTranscripts::test_unlinked_filter_returns_only_zero_link_sessions` — seeds one linked + one unlinked transcript, verifies `?unlinked=true` returns only the unlinked row + `linked_commit_count=0`.
